name: MIL-STD-810H Change 1: Method 514.8 Category 24 general minimum integrity
source: MIL-STD-810H w/Change 1 (18 May 2022), Method 514.8, Annex E, Figure 514.8E-1, printed page 514.8E-3 (PDF page 457).

standard_reference.rolloff_note: The nominal -6 dB/octave segment is represented by a fourfold PSD decrease per octave (f^-2), from 0.04 at 1000 Hz to 0.01 at 2000 Hz. The 2000 Hz density is reconstructed from the nominal slope.
standard_reference.limitation: Annex E excludes minimum-integrity testing from qualification use; this profile is not an aircraft-specific operational environment.
